newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australis appeals against satellite ruling.
newsitem.headline: Australis appeals against satellite ruling.

text.p: Satellite television operator Australis Media Ltd said on Tuesday it filed an appeal against the recent court ruling that blocked its proposed satellite joint venture with Optus Vision.
Australis said the application seeking expedition of the appeal has been listed for June 23.

On May 30, the Supreme Court of New South Wales (NSW) ruled against the joint infrastructure venture between Australis and Optus Vision, following litigation by rival pay TV network Foxtel and its owners News Corp Ltd and government owned telecommunications group Telstra Corp Ltd.
The Optus Vision-Australis venture was agreed upon last year and approved by the anti-monopolies body, the Australian Competition and Consumer Commission (ACCC).
The satellite deal was seen as an important part of the recapitalisation of Australis and a step towards the expected shake-up in Australia's loss making pay-TV industry.
Optus Vision is a unit of telephone carrier Optus Communications Pty Ltd.
